name: Voice presets
markdown:
# Voice presets

> From the author's earlier studio, cleaned for publication: private paths, ports and some lines were removed, so a step may read short and a screen it names may not exist here. Status in this studio: Tested on the author's old stack.


## Not cloning
These voices use **no reference recording**. They sit in their own group of the Voice tab's generator list ("Preset
voices (no cloning, no reference voice)"), apart from the clone engines; the saved-voice picker and its consent form are
not shown for them, because there is no one's voice to consent for. Voice cloning (OmniVoice / ChatterBox) and its
consent gate are unchanged. A voice description or instruction that names a real person, or asks for an impersonation /
soundalike, is refused (the clone path's likeness words and the text guard's named people).

## Which one
| Entry | Voice | Best for | Measured |
|---|---|---|---|
| Qwen3-TTS "Ryan" | male, native English preset | narration with numbers, dates, prices | WER 0.00 short / 0.06 long / 0.00 emotional; RTF 0.9-1.5 |
| Qwen3-TTS "Aiden" | male, native English preset | the same, a second timbre | WER 0.00 / 0.12 / 0.00 |
| FireRedTTS3 voice design | a NEW voice from your description | short lines in a voice you describe | WER 0.00 short / 0.15-0.21 long; RTF ~1 |

Serena (a Chinese preset reading English) misread "1,250" in the test and is not offered.

## In the studio
1. Voice tab → the generator list → "Preset voices (no cloning…)".
2. Type the line in the prompt box (spoken as typed, never enhanced). Qwen: up to 2000 characters. FireRed: up to 300
   (short lines read best; it says "on the 3rd of March" for dates).
3. Qwen: optional `instruct` field, e.g. `Speak with shocked, hurt anger, voice rising.` (the tested emotional line).
4. FireRed: `voice_description`: who + pitch / texture + pace + tone. Pre-filled with the tested narrator; the other two
   "A confident female news presenter in her forties, crisp neutral accent, steady medium pace, professional tone."

## Settings
| Setting | Value | Source |
|---|---|---|
| FireRedTTS3 | FireRedTTS3Instruct(wetext on, llm_tn off).generate_voice_design(…, language English) | [tested] ut_fr3vd; [documented] KB FIREREDTTS3.md (README defaults: cfg 1.2, 10 steps) |
| Watermark | PerTh implicit watermark, verified (fail closed), 16-bit mono WAV | the studio's voice rule (studio/_voice_cli.py `watermark`) |

## Time and VRAM
- Qwen: first call ~33 s (worker start + load), then RTF 0.9-1.5. It runs in its comfy-env worker (~5.4 GB) that **stays
  on the card after the job**; `/free` on  a local port does not release it.
- FireRed: own venv `a local folder`, 7.4 s load, 15.1 GiB process peak (16 GiB budgeted + 4 GiB headroom; it waits
  for an idle card, unlike the small clone engines).

## Licence
- Qwen3-TTS: Apache-2.0 (README / repo licence).
- FireRedTTS3: Apache-2.0 code; the README's disclaimer says its zero-shot voice cloning is "intended solely for academic

## Guards
The text guard reads the line and the description / instruction. The output guard checks the audio file like every
studio result.

## Evidence
- Manifest rows `ut_qtts_*`, `ut_fr3vd`; results `results_par_untested_20261011_plocal.jsonl`; clips in
  `a local folder`, `ut_fr3vd__*`. WER scorer: faster-whisper large-v3 + the
  Whisper English normaliser (the bake-off's).
- https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-TTS · https://github.com/FireRedTeam/FireRedTTS3
